svg.title: Decentralized Voting Architectures and Anti-Collusion Paradigms
svg.desc: Taxonomy of blockchain voting systems: Token-weighted plutocracy, Quadratic Voting, gasless off-chain signaling, and MACI ZK-SNARK anti-collusion.
svg.text: Decentralized Voting Architectures & Anti-Collusion Paradigms
Comparing plutocratic on-chain execution, quadratic preference aggregation, and zero-knowledge privacy
1. Token-Weighted Voting (1 Token = 1 Vote)
Implementations: GovernorBravo, OpenZeppelin Governor
Execution: Direct on-chain binding with TimelockController
Strength: Capital alignment, unforgeable sybil defense
Weakness: Plutocracy; whale wallets dictate all outcomes
2. Quadratic Voting (Cost = Votes^2)
Implementations: Gitcoin Grants, RadicalxChange
Formula: 1 vote = 1 credit, 2 votes = 4, 10 votes = 100
Strength: Amplifies broad consensus over concentrated wealth
Vulnerability: Extremely vulnerable to Sybil identity splitting
3. Gasless Off-Chain Signaling (Snapshot)
Implementations: Snapshot.org, SafeSnap (Zodiac)
Mechanism: EIP-712 cryptographic signatures stored on IPFS
Strength: Zero gas fees encourages massive voter turnout
Execution: Non-binding advice, or optimistic oracle relay
4. Anti-Collusion ZK Infrastructure (MACI)
Implementations: Minimum Anti-Collusion Infrastructure
Mechanism: Key changes encrypted via ZK-SNARK circuits
Strength: Voters cannot prove how they voted to bribery cartels
Eliminates on-chain vote buying & extortion markets
Source: Vitalik Buterin Quadratic Voting Research, MACI Ethereum Foundation Specs, OpenZeppelin Governor Architecture
